description: The tables link_query can read and the keys that join them: datasets to lookup tables to Census geography. With no arguments, a short index: each dataset's `table` name for SQL (e.g. 'education.attendance', its default detail level), what one row is (`grain`), detail levels, and join keys, plus each lookup table's name (e.g. 'dimensions.districts'). `tables` (names from the index, e.g. 'education.attendance', 'education/gosa/attendance', 'attendance', or 'districts') returns those tables in full: every column and a table name per detail level ('education.attendance__districts'). `main_topic` limits either form to one subject area.

main_topic.description: Only datasets in this subject area. Omit for all.
main_topic.title: Main Topic

tables.description: Tables to return in full. Omit for the short index.
